fusions.name: Collar and Hold
fusions.desc: Seizes the target and holds it fast, which deals 15 damage, stuns it for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrist Lock
fusions.desc: Wrenches the target's arm: the strike deals 4 damage and leaves it [Bruised] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: White Knuckles
fusions.desc: Your attacks come 25% faster for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Lifter's Chalk
fusions.desc: Conjures a pouch of grip chalk: your critical chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 15% more, each kill returns 3 health, and your maximum health rises by 10.
